Ergonomically designed soft-grip handle for additional comfort and control whilst working. Blade constructed from high-grade stainless steel for corrosion resistance, durability and maximum flexibility. Finger guard offers protection against calluses. The blade is fused with a strong mounting which strengthens the entire structure of corner trowel. Perfect for 90° flexing and smoothing with minimal effort, in order to achieve smooth corners.
